text:
samir: Hey team — just noticed our March invoice charged $42.67 even though our promo bucket still shows 1,200 free credits in the dashboard. We used embeddings on 2026-03-05 and expected the promo to cover it. Org ID org-57, billing email samir@acme.com. Invoice INV-20260305-1234. Can someone check why promo didn't apply?

sasha: Sorry about that — can you confirm whether you changed plan in the middle of the billing cycle? Also can you paste the last 4 of the invoice number and a quick screenshot of the credits page?

samir: We upgraded free -> Pro via console on 2026-03-04 around 22:10 UTC. Screenshot attached in thread. Invoice last 4 is 1234.

kevin: Looking into ledger now. One quick note from initial query: there is a credit row for org-57 but it's in state `holding` and wasn't counted by the nightly invoice job. Tagging matt from usage infra.

matt: FWIW we have a small race when promos are applied at the same time as plan changes: apply_promo job sets a credit row with state `holding` and finalize_promo moves it to `available` on the next cron. Invoice job reads only `available` credits. If the plan swap and apply_promo happen within the same minute the finalize job can miss the window.

kevin: SQL I ran to confirm: ```SELECT id, state, amount, created_at FROM credits WHERE org_id='org-57' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 5; -- result: id=cr_9a8b, state='holding', amount=1200, created_at='2026-03-04T22:14:10Z'```

sasha: Thanks — that matches what samir reported. Short-term: I can issue a manual release and a credit memo to reverse the invoice charge. Long-term: we need to make invoice job consider credits in `holding` that have an `applied_at` timestamp <= invoice run time, or move finalize earlier.

billing-bot: Invoice INV-20260305-1234 marked refunded (memo BN-7890) by sasha at 2026-03-06T03:12:10Z.

kevin: I created a repro script and a failing test. Plan: patch invoice runner to include `holding` credits with `applied_at IS NOT NULL` (PR #2345). Will add metric `billing.credits.holding_count` and an alert when >5 in 10m for production. ETA for patch: today, deploy + canary tomorrow.

samir: Appreciate the fast turnaround. Can you confirm we got the refund and that the promo credits are now usable?

sasha: Done — I released the holding credit and applied it to the org. Refund processed for $42.67. Credits now show as 1,200 available. BN-7890 memo in billing. Please verify on your side. :thumbsup:

samir: Verified — credits available and invoice shows refunded. Thanks!

matt: Follow-ups for infra: 1) change invoice read to include `applied_at` holding credits; 2) add unit + integration tests to simulate plan swap + promo; 3) run migration to backfill any credits stuck in `holding` for >1h. I'll file JIRA INFRA-1122 and link PR.

kevin: Also adding a one-off script to scan the last 30 days for credits in `holding` with applied_at < invoice_time and create tickets for manual review.

sasha: Marking thread resolved. If you see anything else, ping support.

samir: Thanks again everyone — great response.
